clan.name: Scythian Griffins
clan.description: We are the Scythian Griffins. Named for that proud Warrior Nation who from the 8th Century BC onwards spread from the Pontic Steppe across most of Eurasia; and for the Griffin, signifying that though once we were Lions, now we can fly.Made up of former Lions Alliance members, we believe in the values of honesty, truth and being a good and fair friend to those who show us the same.We have some expectations:- Complete at least GE level 3- QI 500 points- fair trades unless pre-organised (1:1 same age, 2:1, 1:2 up or down one age)- contributions to mud threads - GbG participation expectedWe have active 1.9 and 1.95 threads, 2.0 threads, and many, many friendly guildies who love to help.Although GBG is not compulsory, we’re slightly obsessed with it so be prepared to get dragged in, even if kicking and screaming.  If you are interested in joining, please contact Ruby
